name: Minh
description: Round face with soft cheeks, short slightly-tousled black hair, warm medium-tan skin tone, lean-average build with relaxed posture; default expression is a sheepish half-smile — the look of someone perpetually caught mid-mistake but still cheerful about it
outfit: Solid sage-green crew-neck t-shirt (no print, no logo), dark navy chino trousers cropped slightly above the ankle, white low-top canvas sneakers
personality: Easygoing and well-meaning but gloriously disorganised — the kind of guy who buys three bunches of cilantro and forgets he already has cilantro at home.
